lines: #Life is *hard.*
Either way.
#Training is hard. Being out of shape is *hard.*
Saving is hard. Being broke is *hard.*
Having the difficult conversation is hard. Living with the *silence* is hard.
#You don't get to choose a life without *hard.*
You only get to choose *which* hard.
#One kind of hard pays you *back.*
The other just keeps *taking.*
#The early alarm hurts for a *minute.*
The regret of wasted years hurts for a *lifetime.*
#Most people pick the hard that feels easier *today.*
And they pay for it *later.* With interest.
Hard now buys easy *later.*
Easy now costs you *more* later.
#So pick the hard that builds you.
Pick the hard that leaves you *stronger.*
The hard that opens *doors* instead of closing them.
#It won't feel good in the *moment.*
But one day, you'll look around at the life you *built.*
And you'll be so glad you chose *this* hard.
#Choose your hard. *Today.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.
